description: This file defines various Pydantic models for API response schemas, including error handling, health status, metrics, and scenario data, used in an API service.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents an error payload with code, message, and optional details.

classes.name: EnvelopeOk
classes.description: Base envelope class for successful responses, with status and optional data.

classes.name: EnvelopeError
classes.description: Envelope class for error responses, including an Error payload.

classes.name: HealthData
classes.description: Contains health status information including uptime, version, and service health indicators.

classes.name: ReadyData
classes.description: Indicates whether the service is ready to serve traffic.

classes.name: EnvelopeCurrentMetrics
classes.description: Envelope for current metrics data, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeHealth
classes.description: Envelope for health status data, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeReady
classes.description: Envelope for readiness status, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeTestStartAccepted
classes.description: Envelope for accepted test start responses, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeTestStopAccepted
classes.description: Envelope for accepted test stop responses, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeTestStatus
classes.description: Envelope for test status responses, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeScenarioList
classes.description: Envelope for list of scenarios, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeScenario
classes.description: Envelope for a single scenario, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeScenarioVersion
classes.description: Envelope for scenario version response, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeReportMeta
classes.description: Envelope for report metadata, extends EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeAccepted
classes.description: Envelope for accepted queued job, extends EnvelopeOk.

methods.name: now_utc
methods.description: Utility function to generate current UTC datetime.
